answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 69367 Country: India Title: Is one sheep or goat in sufficient as udhiyah for one man and his family? Question: Is one sheep sufficient as udhiyah for one man and his family and whoever he wants among the Muslims? Answer ID: 69367 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1028/981/B=12/1437) No, sheep, ram and goat may only suffice for a person. It is not lawful to share someone else in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
